action: Check every NGINX Open Source and NGINX Plus server that serves HTTP/2. Apply the fixed versions from F5 bulletins K000163926 and K000163928, or disable HTTP/2 until patched (remove http2 from the listen line, or set http2 off on 1.25.0 and earlier). Review exposed servers for signs of compromise.
exec: NGINX is among the most widely used web servers and proxies; an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw with a public proof of concept makes exposed servers urgent to patch or mitigate.
plain: French cyber agency warns of two flaws in the NGINX web server that could let an attacker run code on a server over HTTP/2, with public attack code available for one of them.

key_findings: Two flaws, CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007, allow unauthenticated remote code execution over HTTP/2.
Affected: NGINX Open Source 1.31.x before 1.31.9 and versions before 1.30.7; NGINX Plus 3.1.x-3.2.x before 3.7.3.0.1 and 3.7.x before 37.0.8.1.
CERT-FR knows of a public proof of concept for CVE-2026-123007; in-the-wild exploitation is not stated.

KrCERT/CC lists five NGINX Plus and Open Source flaws fixed by F5: CVE-2026-123007 (integer underflow) and use-after-free CVE-2026-123634, CVE-2026-123633, CVE-2026-121810 and CVE-2026-113425; it urges updating to the fixed versions (Open Source 1.30.7 or 1.31.9).
recommendations: Disable HTTP/2 as an interim workaround.

summary: CERT-FR warns that two flaws in F5 NGINX Open Source and NGINX Plus, CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007, allow unauthenticated remote code execution over HTTP/2. It knows of a public proof of concept for CVE-2026-123007. Affected are Open Source 1.31.x before 1.31.9 and earlier branches before 1.30.7, and Plus before the fixed releases. Disabling HTTP/2 is an interim workaround. KrCERT/CC lists three further use-after-free flaws fixed in the same F5 update.
title: CERT-FR: NGINX flaws allow unauthenticated remote code execution over HTTP/2; public PoC exists

validation.note: Compared CERT-FR (primary) with Rapid7 (PoC author): CVE-2026-123007 HTTP/2 flaw, fixes 1.31.9 and 1.30.7, public PoC, no in-the-wild exploitation stated. Rapid7 notes its PoC needs about 128 GB of HTTP/2 data and a specific x86-64 glibc, and gives no HTTP/2-off workaround; that workaround is CERT-FR advice. Not compared: CVE-2026-123633 (only CERT-FR).

review.note: Compared title, CVE-2026-123633/123007, affected and fixed versions, public PoC for 123007 only, HTTP/2 workaround against CERT-FR; KrCERT five-CVE list and Rapid7 PoC (no in-the-wild exploitation stated)
